bias.en: Bullish turn · breaking out of the range
bias.zh: 转为偏多 · 突破区间

read.en: Amazon closed at $262.43 on Oct 9, its highest close since Aug 28, and above every average on the chart. The 5 and 10-day averages have pulled above the flat 30 and 100-day ones, MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 5 and is strengthening, RSI is 59, and Parabolic SAR has been below price since Oct 2. Daily swings are a modest 2.2%.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月9日收于 $262.43，为 8月28日以来最高收盘，并位于图上所有均线之上。5 日与 10 日均线已升至走平的 30 日与 100 日均线上方，MACD 于 10月5日上穿信号线并增强，RSI 为 59，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起位于股价下方。日均波幅仅 2.2%。

read.en: Next resistance is $266–268 (the late-August highs); clearing that opens $275–279 and then the Aug 3 high of $287. Support is $257 (tested four times in September), then $252–254 where the 30 and 100-day averages sit together, and $248, the floor of the range since September.
read.zh: 下一阻力为 $266–268（8月下旬高点）；突破后看 $275–279，再看 8月3日高点 $287。支撑为 $257（9月四次测试），其次是 30 日与 100 日均线重叠的 $252–254，再次是 9月以来的区间底部 $248。
